criterion: official L1 plus default uncertainty, ambient, entropy and local regularity terms
primary_weights: EMA at fixed final step, as official validation; preserve raw weights too
audio_encoder: official AVE frozen eval, independently verified cache with WAV/feature/source seals
validation_selection: rounded linspace over all 550 val rows, fixed before training
primary_checkpoint: fixed final step 60000; no test-based selection
convergence_diagnostic: For each model and input gain, compare median val MSE at 40000/42000/44000/46000/48000 against 52000/54000/56000/58000/60000. Plateau screen: abs(relative change)<=.02; worsening>.02 flags deterioration. Report actual curve and mouth metrics; do not claim statistical convergence from this heuristic.
order_and_randomness: one frozen 60000-row frame order shared by all arms; distinct deterministic per-step seeds for occupancy, ray sampling and forward perturbation; verify every ray-index hash across arms
scoring_audio: unaltered original source PCM16 for each of four fixed test clips; same bytes for all 9 cells
scoring: shared ground-truth-owned ROI; FFV1/PCM; SyncNet V2 FP32; guard20 primary, full secondary; C,Dmin,D0,B,offset
test_clips: all four 250-frame clips frozen in prepared dataset manifest
test_reconstruction: all 1100 supervised test frames per cell; primary scored clips exclude temporal attention edges
repeat_control: final train0/test0 rerender repeat on first test clip; compare float frames, RGB and SyncNet
scope: one English identity, one seed, fixed first-stage ray/update budget; engineering pilot, not multi-identity or complete official two-stage replication
precision_rationale: FP32 optimization: equal successful optimizer-update budget, no AMP overflow/skipped steps
